sloka: तत इन्द्रजितं नाम द्वितीयं रावणः सुतम् ।व्यादिदेश सुसंक्रुद्धो बलिनं युद्धदुर्मदम् ।। ५.५८.१२५ ।।।।
transliteration: tata indrajitaṁ nāma dvitīyaṁ rāvaṇaḥ sutam ।vyādideśa susaṁkruddho balinaṁ yuddhadurmadam ।। 5.58.125 ।।।।

translations.english: "When Aksha was done to death, the tenfaced Ravana was enraged and gave instruction to the second son, called Indrajit who was thirsting for war.
